response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval) SELECT healtheval, total_scans, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean FROM g WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM g) IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The ratio gbsize/spanmin is computed per scan row, and the status average is the AVG of those row ratios. It is not total gbsize divided by total spanmin.
A spanmin of 0 is treated as a missing value, so NULLIF avoids division by zero and the row is ignored in the average.
The mean of all status-level averages is an unweighted mean across statuses. Statuses whose average is NULL are ignored. If no status has an average, no rows are returned.
Scans whose site has a NULL healtheval form their own group. The inner join drops scans with no matching site.
